I farm cabbage three times a year on my 20 mu. My man and me, just two of us now. I been doing this thirty years, my hands know the work.

Here is how I think about this year:

For each cabbage planting, I buy the seedlings from the same man in town, the improved kind like everyone around here uses. The old seeds nobody plants anymore, you cannot sell those cabbages at market.

Fertilizer — I put on plenty. My neighbor Liu's wife last year tried to save money, her heads came out small, she lost money at the buyer. I rather spend the money and get big heads. Before planting I spread 3 bags of compound fertilizer per mu (that is one big bag of 50 jin plus some). Then when the heads start to form I side-dress with urea, maybe 1 bag per mu. For the autumn cabbage I give a little more because those heads need to be heavy for winter storage buyers.

Water — I got the well, thank heaven. Cabbage drinks a lot. I water maybe 7, 8 times each planting. When it is hot in summer I water more, maybe every 5, 6 days.

Bug spray — the worms eat cabbage bad, especially summer. The dealer in town sells me the spray, I go 5 times each crop, maybe 6 for summer one when the worms are worst. If I skip, the heads get holes, buyer pays less.

Ploughing — I pay the man with the rotary tiller, 40 yuan a mu. Between each cabbage crop he comes. My back cannot turn soil anymore.

Yield — spring cabbage good year I get 6000 jin per mu, summer one less because heat, autumn is the best, 7000 or more for storage cabbage.
